title: @c15t/schema: Consent API Schemas and Types
description: Valibot schemas and TypeScript types for the c15t consent API. The c15t backend, frontends, and Node.js SDK share them, so requests and responses match on both sides.
features: Valibot schemas for consent API requests and responses
TypeScript types inferred from the same schemas
